title: Sports in General - Tennis
content: Tennis "Tennis is my favorite sport." "I play tennis just for fun." "I started playing tennis when I was in high school." "I made the varsity team in high school when I have been only playing for 3 months." "I used to have a girlfriend who left me to be with a tennis coach." "I can't hit a back hand." "I have a two handed back hand." "One handed back hands are more effective for attacks." "You can generate more power by using one hand for your backhand." "How do you topspin a ball?" "Every time I try to lob a ball, it always goes out." "My serves need a lot of help." "My second serve is too easy to hit." "I can't believe how fast professional tennis players serve." "A guy once died from getting hit with a tennis ball in the crotch at a professional tournament. He was an old guy and got a stroke from the shock or pain." "My favorite tennis player is Agassi." "Martina Hingis is the cutest tennis player." "I hate playing against a serve and volley type of player." "I'm a baseline player."
